resources.string: At the end of an outing, its trace can go to Health Connect and to Strava. Nothing is sent without you.
Send automatically at the end of the outing
Allowed: each outing sent is written as a skiing session with its route.
Allow skimap to write your outings (skiing session and route).
Health Connect must be installed or updated.
Health Connect is not available on this phone.
Connecting to Strava will be possible once the skimap service is set up for Strava.
The skimap service cannot be reached. Try again with a network.
Outings are uploaded as Nordic ski (or backcountry ski in nordic backcountry practice), with the conditions of the day in the description. Without a network they wait and go as soon as it is back.
Strava did not give the permission to upload activities.
The Strava answer does not match the request: connect again.

When you send an outing, skimap writes it to Health Connect: a skiing session with its start and end time, its route (the positions recorded during the outing), its name and the recap. skimap reads nothing from Health Connect and sends this data nowhere else. You can remove the permission at any time in the Health Connect settings.
